text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Elevated 5xx + timeouts observed for model-serving ingress in eu-central. Spike started ~2951234500. Auto-alert triggered (threshold: 4% 5xx over 5m).

alex: I'm paging oncall-mlinfra and eng-sre. Priya can you dump a quick traffic heatmap?

priya: Traffic: 70% of requests to /v1/generate from eu clients are hitting eu-central. Error breakdown: 502 upstream_connect (60%), 504 gateway timeout (30%), 503 service_unavailable (10%).

sam: Seeing a sharp rise in connection resets from the edge -> ingress-proxy. Logs show repeated "connect() failed (111: Connection refused) to upstream" from ingress nodes eu-central-a.

liu: Checking worker pools — ML workers in eu-central report increased kernel OOMs and long GC pauses on the quantized runtime. Also noticed `nat-gateway` metric spike: SNAT port exhaustion possibility.

jen: Customer impact: 6 customers with >5% of requests failing; 1 production customer (acct: acme-payments) reporting timeouts on embeddings endpoint. Notified CS.

marco: Quick command outputs: ```
# kubectl get pods -n ingress -o wide
ingress-proxy-0   2/2 Running   45d   10.128.3.12   eu-central-a
ingress-proxy-1   1/2 CrashLoop   4m   10.128.3.13   eu-central-b
``` 
Also ```
# ip-nat stats
snat_alloc_failures: 12432
active_snat_ports: 65531/65536
``` 
Looks like SNAT pool near exhaustion.

oncall-mlinfra: Confirmed SNAT exhaustion on a subset of NAT instances. That would cause upstream connect failures and packet drops -> 5xx. We should reduce outbound port usage from workers and spin up additional NAT capacity.

alex: Mitigations we can attempt now: 1) enable temporary traffic steering for affected model-route to eu-west (route shift 50% -> 100%), 2) apply short-term 429-based ingress rate-limit for anonymous clients, 3) add NAT instances/rotate IPs. Thoughts?

eng-sre: I'll start NAT scale-up (infra autoscale might be slow). Running `infractl nat add --region eu-central --count 3` now. ETA ~3m. Also enabling SNAT port reuse kernel flag across nodes (low risk) — patching via rolling daemonset.

priya: I'll begin a controlled traffic shift: `infractl route shift --service model-serving --from eu-central --to eu-west --percent 50 --reason "mitigate snat exhaustion"` — doing dry-run then execute.

sam: Recommend also applying circuit-breaker on long-running routes: set max-inflight 8 and enqueue policy drop for top-of-queue. That reduces pressure on ML workers.

liu: Rolling a config to set max-inflight on embedding-v1 to 8 for eu-central only. `kubectl apply -f cb-embed-euc.yaml` — rolling now.

alex: Priya, execute traffic shift when ready. Eng-sre keep me posted on NAT scale. Oncall-mlinfra, keep monitoring GC/oom trends and let us know if worker capacity needs scaling.

priya: Executing traffic shift -> 50% now. Metrics: 5xx rate fell from 7.4% -> 3.1% in 60s for eu-central. Latency improved by ~200ms for successful calls.

eng-sre: NAT instances added and active. SNAT failure counts dropping. Patch to enable reuse applied to 3/3 nodes.

marco: Confirming ingress-proxy crashloops reduced (ingress-proxy-1 restarted and stabilized). Kernel OOM events decreasing.

jen: Customer update: Acme-payments sees errors down to ~2% now. CS has been notified of partial mitigation and handoff.

alex: Good. Let's keep the 50% shift for 20m while NAT metrics stabilize. Post 20m, if stable, we can move back or keep 20% via smart-routing. Also open a paging ticket for follow-up RCA and capacity plan.

oncall-mlinfra: Agreed. Handoff to eng-sre for final infrastructure stabilization. I'll stay on the thread for context and handoff notes.

eng-sre: Taking lead. Will file incident ticket and tag network + infra for SNAT pool increase and long-term fix (load-balancer egress redesign). ETA for incident ticket: 10m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT ESCALATION: Assigned -> eng-sre. Severity set to Sev2. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingress-snat-exhaustion

sam: Quick note for RCA: need to correlate client connection patterns — one client (internal stress-test) appeared to open many ephemeral connections. Querying logs for top talkers.

marco: Found suspicious traffic from service/qa-loadgen in eu-central-dev account starting at 2951234400. Notified owner to throttle. That likely tipped the SNAT pool.

alex: Action items: [eng-sre] file incident ticket + long-term fix; [infra] bump SNAT pool and revisit egress architecture; [mlinfra] evaluate connection reuse and keepalive on worker side to reduce ephemeral ports; [product] check rate-limit defaults and accounts with high fanout.

jen: I'll prepare a short customer-facing incident note for affected customers with timeline and current mitigation.

priya: Monitoring continues. Will post final status in ~20m or sooner if regression.

alex: Thanks everyone. React with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your action. Handoff complete from oncall-mlinfra -> eng-sre. :handshake:

(End of thread)
